integrity: Primary equation and date inspected in openly accessible publisher full text; symbolic identities and numerical cross-checks replayed from a standalone program, but the global theorem is justified analytically. Some potentially related old Duffing papers were not examined in full. Scientific comparison is same-model only.
scientific_limitations: The global assertion is proved only for \(B\ge0\), \(\varepsilon>0\), and \(B\varepsilon^2\le1/256\) in the exactly resonant, single-well forced equation. No statement is made about the originating large-drive chaotic parameter examples; the explicit bound is sufficient, not sharp. \(O(\varepsilon^6)\) is at fixed B, alpha, beta. No claim about independent validation or exclusive worldwide priority.
title: Universal resonant rectification and axial escape in an exponential Duffing lift
